diagnostic_review.interpretation: The already-failing multisample texture NVRTC reference remains infrastructure, return 1, executed 1, passed 0. Debug stops at CPPSourceEmitter::_getTypeName null-handle assertion; RelWithDebInfo reaches NVRTC with missing texture type declarations, which NVRTC rejects. The census parser leaves its diagnostic field empty for these NVRTC lines, so the exact raw diagnostics are retained separately. This is an existing unsupported-case defect exposed differently by host configuration, not a newly lost pass or accepted output.
code_trace: source/slang/slang-emit-cpp.cpp:117 CPPSourceEmitter::_getTypeName initializes a null handle, calls calcTypeName, and only fills the handle on success; the null handle is asserted at line 133 before getSlice.
source/core/slang-common.h:363 SLANG_ASSERT throws under _DEBUG; its non-debug definition is SLANG_ASSUME.
